failure_modes.name: Entity_Coreference_Error
failure_modes.evidence: The claim states 'The player that played for the Republic of Ireland national team after Inter Milan' as a descriptive reference. Passage from hop 3 '2000–01 Inter Milan season' shows Keane played for Inter Milan in the 2000-01 season. Another passage from hop 3 'Robbie Keane' states he 'served as captain of the Republic of Ireland national team from March 2006 until his international retirement in August 2016'. This establishes Keane played for Ireland after Inter Milan (2000-01 preceded 2006-2016), yet the solver never explicitly resolves that 'the player' in the claim definitively refers to Robbie Keane, nor connects the temporal sequence to verify the 'after' relationship.
